## Oscillatory descriptors

#### K-means clusterisation

<!-- Per-dataset namespace via `DatasetCtx`. Each dataset (iEEG, reconstructed sources) populates its own ctx object so globals never collide. -->

```{python}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from pesco.experimental.clustering import (
    cluster_bands,
    cluster_peak_frequencies,
    find_k_with_no_peak,
    get_no_peak,
    order_clusters_by_peak,
)
from pesco.experimental.peak_testing import (
    compute_intervals,
    cutintervals,
    test_lobes,
    test_regions,
    test_regions_heatmap,
)
from pesco.experimental.plotting import (
    plot_cluster_brain,
    plot_clusters,
    plot_clusters_pair,
    plot_histogram,
    plot_lobes,
    plot_region_difference_heatmap,
    plot_region_difference_heatmap_pair,
    plot_regions,
    plot_lobes_pair,
)
from pesco.io import load_sources, prepare_psd
from pesco.pipeline import DatasetCtx
from pesco.preprocess import compute_psd, normalize_psd

seed = 3
np.random.seed(seed)

PROJECT_DIR = Path("/Users/daniel/PhD/spectral-comparison/code/")
DATA_PATH_SOURCES = Path(f"{PROJECT_DIR}/data/Mantini2018")
DATA_PATH_IEEG = Path(f"{PROJECT_DIR}/data/Frauscher2018")

NO_PEAK_SUMMARY = "mean"
PLOT_SUMMARY = "median"
```

# compute clasterisation iEEG

```{python}
ieeg = DatasetCtx(name="intracranial data")
ieeg.f, ieeg.psd = prepare_psd(
    matfile = DATA_PATH_IEEG / "WakefulnessMatlabFile.mat",
    region_dict_file = DATA_PATH_IEEG / "RegionInformation.csv",
    frauscher_bandpass=False,
    normalize=True,
    freq_range=(0.5, 80),
)
assert ieeg.psd is not None

ieeg.psd
```

```{python}
k, ieeg.psd_clust, ieeg.smal = find_k_with_no_peak(
    ieeg.psd,
    k_range=range(2, 16),
    feature_cols=ieeg.f,
    summary=NO_PEAK_SUMMARY,
    random_seed=seed,
)

print(f"selected k={k}, no-peak cluster(s): {ieeg.smal}")

no_peak_df, no_peak_center = get_no_peak(
    ieeg.psd_clust, ieeg.smal, feature_cols=ieeg.f, summary=NO_PEAK_SUMMARY,
)

assert no_peak_df is not None and no_peak_center is not None
ieeg.no_peak_df = no_peak_df
ieeg.no_peak_center = no_peak_center
```



```{python}
ieeg.peaks = cluster_peak_frequencies(
    ieeg.psd_clust,
    ieeg.f,
    summary=PLOT_SUMMARY,
    baseline=ieeg.no_peak_center,
    freq_range=(1.0, 80.0),
    feature_cols=ieeg.f,
    no_peak=ieeg.smal,
)
print(ieeg.peaks)
```

# HD EEG


```{python}
SOURCE_DURATION_SECONDS = 60.0
SOURCE_START_SECONDS = None  # None: centered 60 s segment
FREQ_RANGE = (1, 80.0)
USE_FRAUSCHER_BINS = True

src = DatasetCtx(name="reconstructed sources")

raw_src, region_meta = load_sources(DATA_PATH_SOURCES)
n_samples = int(SOURCE_DURATION_SECONDS * raw_src.info["sfreq"])
if n_samples > raw_src.n_times:
    raise ValueError("Source recording shorter than SOURCE_DURATION_SECONDS.")
if SOURCE_START_SECONDS is None:
    src_start = (raw_src.n_times - n_samples) // 2
else:
    src_start = int(SOURCE_START_SECONDS * raw_src.info["sfreq"])
src_stop = src_start + n_samples
print(f"source PSD segment: {src_start / raw_src.info['sfreq']:.1f}-{src_stop / raw_src.info['sfreq']:.1f} s")

data = raw_src.get_data(start=src_start, stop=src_stop)
src.f, psd_arr = compute_psd(
    data, raw_src.info["sfreq"], fmin=FREQ_RANGE[0], fmax=FREQ_RANGE[1],
)
psd_arr = normalize_psd(psd_arr, src.f)
src.psd = pd.DataFrame(
    psd_arr, index=raw_src.info["ch_names"], columns=src.f,
).join(region_meta)
src.psd
```

```{python}
_, src.psd_clust, src.smal = find_k_with_no_peak(
    src.psd,
    k_range=range(2, 16),
    feature_cols=src.f,
    summary=NO_PEAK_SUMMARY,
    random_seed=seed,
)
print(f"no-peak cluster(s): {src.smal}")

no_peak_df, no_peak_center = get_no_peak(
    src.psd_clust, src.smal, feature_cols=src.f, summary=NO_PEAK_SUMMARY,
)
assert no_peak_df is not None and no_peak_center is not None
src.no_peak_df = no_peak_df
src.no_peak_center = no_peak_center
```

```{python}
src.peaks = cluster_peak_frequencies(
    src.psd_clust,
    src.f,
    summary=PLOT_SUMMARY,
    baseline=src.no_peak_center,
    freq_range=(1.0, 80.0),
    feature_cols=src.f,
    no_peak=src.smal,
)
print(src.peaks)
```

```{python}
    src.psd_clust,
    src.f,
    src.name,
    src.smal,
    nopeak=src.smal[0] if src.smal else None,
    summary="mean",
    log_y=True,
    order_by_peak=True,
    peak_baseline=src.no_peak_center,
    peak_freq_range=(1.0, 80.0),
    feature_cols=src.f,
    label_by_band=True,
)
#fig.savefig("reconstructed_sources_clusters.png", dpi=600, bbox_inches="tight")

```



```{python}
USE_FRAUSCHER_BINS = True
if USE_FRAUSCHER_BINS:
    src.colbin, _ = cutintervals(src.f)
else:
    df = src.f[1] - src.f[0]
    band = src.f <= 45.0
    ref = src.psd[list(src.f[band])].median(axis=0).to_numpy()
    edges = compute_intervals(src.f[band], ref)
    # cuts derived ≤45 Hz; collapse 45-80 Hz noise tail into one trailing bin
    edges = np.append(edges[:-1], src.f[-1] + df / 2)
    src.colbin, _ = cutintervals(src.f, edges=edges)
    print(f"derived {len(src.colbin.categories)} intervals (paper: 22): {np.round(edges, 2)}")

src.regional_diff = test_regions_heatmap(
    no_peak_df=src.no_peak_df,
    psd=src.psd,
    colbin=src.colbin,
)
src.sig_lobes = test_lobes(src.no_peak_df, src.psd, src.colbin)
src.sig_regions = test_regions(src.no_peak_df, src.psd, src.colbin)
```

```{python}
#| output: true

fig, ax = plot_region_difference_heatmap(
    src.regional_diff,
    title=f"Significant differences between regions and no-peak cluster of {src.name}",
    reference_df= ieeg.regional_diff,
    annot_fontsize=7,
)
#fig.savefig(f"images/{src.name}_all_regional_differences.png", bbox_inches="tight")
```

```{python}
#| output: true

# Lobar differences via the faceting mechanism (combined plot; plot_lobes_pair kept above).
# Modality = Bundles facet (rows), lobes = GroupBy facet (cols); swap row<->col to transpose.
from pesco.experimental.facets import FacetGrid, Bundles, GroupBy, psd_panel

fig = (
    FacetGrid(
        row=Bundles([ieeg, src], label="name"),
        col=GroupBy("Lobe"),
        sharey=True, wspace=0.06, panel_size=(4, 3),
    )
    .map(psd_panel(summary=PLOT_SUMMARY, xlim=(1, 80), tick_labelsize=10))
    .label(x="Frequency [Hz]", y="Normalized spectral density")
    .finish(suptitle="Lobar differences vs no-peak cluster: iEEG vs reconstructed sources")
)
fig.savefig("figures/chapter2/combined_lobar_differences_faceted.pdf", bbox_inches="tight")
```

```{python}
    FacetGrid(col=Bundles([ieeg, src], label="name"), sharey=True, panel_size=(10, 5.5))
```

# Linear log cluster


```{python}
#| output: true

# Average RAW (non-normalized) spectra per modality, on one log-log scale.
# Makes visible the absolute-power scale gap that unit-integral normalisation removes.
from plotnine import (
    aes, element_blank, element_line, element_text, geom_line, geom_ribbon,
    ggplot, labs, scale_alpha_manual, scale_linetype_manual, scale_x_log10,
    scale_y_log10, theme, theme_bw,
)

# iEEG: raw V²/Hz (normalize=False)
ieeg_raw_f, ieeg_raw_psd = prepare_psd(
    matfile=DATA_PATH_IEEG / "WakefulnessMatlabFile.mat",
    region_dict_file=DATA_PATH_IEEG / "RegionInformation.csv",
    frauscher_bandpass=False, normalize=False, freq_range=(1, 80),
)
# HD-EEG: raw source PSD over the same 60 s segment (skip normalize_psd)
hd_raw_f, hd_raw_psd = compute_psd(
    raw_src.get_data(start=src_start, stop=src_stop),
    raw_src.info["sfreq"], fmin=1.0, fmax=80.0,
)


def _raw_long(f, arr, name):
    df = pd.DataFrame(np.asarray(arr, dtype=float), columns=np.asarray(f, dtype=float))
    long = df.melt(var_name="frequency", value_name="spectral_density")
    long["frequency"] = pd.to_numeric(long["frequency"])
    long["dataset"] = name
    return long


raw_long = pd.concat([
    _raw_long(ieeg_raw_f, ieeg_raw_psd[list(ieeg_raw_f)].to_numpy(), ieeg.name),
    _raw_long(hd_raw_f, hd_raw_psd, src.name),
], ignore_index=True)

raw_summary = (
    raw_long.groupby(["dataset", "frequency"], as_index=False)
    .agg(
        median=("spectral_density", "median"),
        q25=("spectral_density", lambda s: s.quantile(0.25)),
        q75=("spectral_density", lambda s: s.quantile(0.75)),
        minimum=("spectral_density", "min"),
        maximum=("spectral_density", "max"),
    )
)
raw_summary["band"] = "IQR (25-75%)"

# long form for the line layers, so median vs min-max becomes a linetype legend
raw_lines = raw_summary.melt(
    id_vars=["dataset", "frequency"],
    value_vars=["median", "minimum", "maximum"],
    var_name="stat", value_name="value",
)
raw_lines["statistic"] = raw_lines["stat"].map(
    {"median": "median", "minimum": "min-max", "maximum": "min-max"}
)
raw_lines["grp"] = raw_lines["dataset"] + "|" + raw_lines["stat"]

g = (
    ggplot()
    + geom_ribbon(
        raw_summary,
        aes("frequency", ymin="q25", ymax="q75", fill="dataset", alpha="band"),
        color=None,
    )
    + geom_line(
        raw_lines,
        aes("frequency", "value", color="dataset", linetype="statistic", group="grp"),
        size=0.8,
    )
    + scale_x_log10(breaks=[1, 4, 8, 13, 30, 80])
    + scale_y_log10()
    + scale_linetype_manual(name="statistic", values={"median": "solid", "min-max": "dotted"})
    + scale_alpha_manual(name="spread", values={"IQR (25-75%)": 0.25})
    + labs(
        x="Frequency (Hz)", y="Raw spectral density",
        color="modality", fill="modality",
        title="Average raw (non-normalized) PSD: iEEG vs HD-EEG",
    )
    + theme_bw()
    + theme(  # match the matplotlib FacetGrid journal style for the composite
        figure_size=(8, 6),
        panel_border=element_blank(),
        axis_line=element_line(color="black", size=0.6),
        panel_grid_minor=element_blank(),
        panel_grid_major=element_line(color="0.85", size=0.4),
        strip_background=element_blank(),
        legend_key=element_blank(),
        text=element_text(size=11),
        axis_title=element_text(size=12),
        axis_text=element_text(size=9),
    )
)
#g.save("figures/chapter2/raw_power_crossmodal.svg", verbose=False)
g
```

```{python}
#| output: true

# Aligned composite via the generic panel composer: a subplot_mosaic grid
# whose named cells are filled by renderer(ax) callables wrapping existing
# plots. All panels are live axes in one figure, so their plot areas align
# exactly (same top/bottom, same log-frequency x) and it stays vector.
from pesco.experimental.facets import compose_panels, raw_spectra_panel


def cluster_cell(ctx_, title):
    return lambda ax: plot_clusters(
        ctx_.psd_clust, ctx_.f, ctx_.name, ctx_.smal,
        nopeak=ctx_.smal[0] if ctx_.smal else None, summary=PLOT_SUMMARY,
        log_y=True, order_by_peak=True, peak_baseline=ctx_.no_peak_center,
        peak_freq_range=(1.0, 80.0), feature_cols=ctx_.f, label_by_band=True,
        ax=ax, show=False, save=False, title=title, legend_fontsize=8, xlim=(1, 80),
    )


fig, axd = compose_panels(
    [["raw", ".", "ieeg", "src"]],  # "." = empty spacer so B's y-label clears A
    {
        "raw": lambda ax: raw_spectra_panel(ax, raw_summary),
        "ieeg": cluster_cell(ieeg, "intracranial data"),
        "src": cluster_cell(src, "reconstructed sources"),
    },
    figsize=(20, 6),
    width_ratios=[1.25, 0.15, 1, 1],
    gridspec_kw={"wspace": 0.08, "top": 0.82},
    sharey_groups=[["ieeg", "src"]],
    letters=[("A", "raw"), ("B", "ieeg"), ("C", "src")],
    letter_format="{}",  # bold "A" (no bracket)
    titles=[
        ("Average raw (non-normalized) PSD", ["raw"]),
        ("Normalized cluster PSDs: iEEG vs HD-EEG", ["ieeg", "src"]),
    ],
    title_pad=0.06,  # clear the cluster panels' column headers
)
axd["ieeg"].set_ylabel("Log normalized spectral density")
axd["src"].set_ylabel("")

fig.savefig("figures/chapter2/rawpower_and_clusters.pdf", bbox_inches="tight")
fig

```
